name_reason: Fully compliant with the global naming convention: data_fd2_ prefix, audio domain, descriptor reflects both purpose (SFX driver available) and data type (flag). No Ghidra address residue. Parallels data_fd2_audio_bgm_driver_available_flag (@0x53EF0, the BGM/MDI equivalent). Confirmed by writer (main sets it 1 in the AIL_install_DIG_INI()!=0 branch) and the two SFX-playback readers that gate on it.
purpose: Boolean gate flag: 1 means the AIL/Miles DIG (digital sample) driver installed successfully and one-shot SFX playback is available; 0 means no DIG driver, so SFX is silent.
logic_summary: BSS uint8 boolean, zero-init. Written exactly once: main @0x25C3B sets it to 1 inside the AIL_install_DIG_INI() != NULL branch (right after storing data_fd2_audio_sfx_dig_driver_handle and allocating sample handles 0/1). Read as a gate by both one-shot SFX players (fd2_play_sfx_with_handle @0x25AA4, fd2_play_sfx_sample_from_bank @0x25B53): each requires this flag AND data_fd2_audio_sfx_enabled_flag non-zero (and the cinematic/terrain flag zero) before invoking AIL stop/init/set-address/start; otherwise it is a silent no-op.
element_semantics: Single scalar boolean: 0 = DIG/SFX driver absent (SFX silent), 1 = DIG/SFX driver installed (SFX playback enabled).
comment_original_issue: src comment block (main.c lines 956-977) already correct and precise -- accurate purpose, writer @0x25C3B, both readers @0x25AA4 / @0x25B53, BSS zero-init uint8 boolean -- all verified against decompile. No change needed.
notes: Ghidra plate was stored in the deprecated PRE_COMMENT field (not PLATE_COMMENT), contained a non-ASCII em-dash, and carried a stale historical note ('Mis-named in Ghidra as current_active_audio_handle' -- that rename already happened; live symbol is data_fd2_audio_sfx_driver_available_flag). Rewrote it into PLATE_COMMENT via run_script_inline Java API (ASCII-only, stale history removed, content aligned with src conclusion) and cleared the old PRE_COMMENT. src/life/main.c not modified (comment kept). content @0x53EF1 = 0x00 (BSS). is_const=false because main has a runtime write-xref (MOV byte ptr [0x53EF1],1).
